El uso de un LoRA está sujeto a la licencia de su autor.

Select: Pick a photo in the Edit a photo block and write what to change: "make the sky a sunset", "remove the person on the right". If the first try is not what you wanted, try another seed. Without a photo the model draws from scratch. Editing takes about 1.3 times as long as plain generation.
